name: Ashebo-CounterflowBench discrete-operator pilot
scope: A fixed-discretization synthetic machine-learning dataset and held-out operator/short-rollout evaluation using the unchanged current-dependent counterflow solver. Not continuum ground truth, a physical prediction, a GENERIC/entropy certificate, or a completed independent blind experiment.
fixed_parameter_family: The preceding audit's continuum_native_caps, fixed p0, current-exchange omega=0.04080087121508541 and j0=4.60963676251496e-16; legacy exchange disabled exactly as in the published current variant. No kernel or Hamiltonian function changes.
initial_family: One declared manufactured-profile neighborhood with independent smooth perturbation coefficients for each seed group. This is not a broad collection of unrelated initial-state families. All kappa variants of a seed group stay in one split.
precision: Native float64 C evolution; independent analytic labels evaluated in numpy.longdouble then serialized in float64 with the declared checks. Complex-step audit uses an independent analytic continuation of the real-coordinate energy on four selected states, not the unmodified native evaluator and not every saved state.
reference_labels: log-content chart state and canonical extensive state
conservative, unit-kappa dissipative and total RHS
bare and complete shell-integrated face fluxes
core zero-crossing diagnostic and validity mask

baseline.algorithm: Supervised dual ridge regression of the conservative RHS, unit-kappa dissipative RHS and unit heat cells. Known linear-in-kappa factorization is built in, not discovered.
baseline.feature_chart: log contents, phases, metric fields and momenta per reference volume; training-only per-coordinate centering and channel scales
baseline.selection: Choose regularization with validation labels only. Save and hash weights and normalizers before reading test files in the baseline script. Score test once; no manual post-test tuning.
baseline.rollout: RK4 with 40 equal substeps to T=0.005; compare all nine saved times, energy-plus-learned-heat and inventory drift. No clipping or repair.

deferred: Long trajectories to native time 500, matched multi-resolution datasets, spatially converged continuum targets, hidden-decomposition identification, neural architectures, independent replication and public benchmark release require separate qualification.
